description: This file defines the ServerRequest class implementing PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface, handling HTTP server request data such as server parameters, cookies, query parameters, uploaded files, and request body. It includes methods for accessing and modifying request attributes, with immutability guarantees.

classes.name: ServerRequest
classes.description: Implements a PSR-7 server-side HTTP request, providing access to server parameters, uploaded files, cookies, query parameters, request body, and attributes, with methods supporting immutability.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new ServerRequest instance with server parameters, uploaded files, URI, method, body, headers, cookies, query parameters, parsed body, and protocol version.

methods.name: getUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns the array of uploaded files.

methods.name: withUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified uploaded files.

methods.name: withCookieParams
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified cookie parameters.

methods.name: withQueryParams
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified query parameters.

methods.name: getParsedBody
methods.description: Returns the parsed body of the request.

methods.name: withParsedBody
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified parsed body, validating its type.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Returns a specific attribute value or default if not present.

methods.name: withAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified attribute set.

methods.name: withoutAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new instance without the specified attribute.

methods.name: validateUploadedFiles
methods.description: Recursively validates the structure of uploaded files, ensuring each leaf is an UploadedFileInterface.
